kebab_example: aliyun slb delete-load-balancer-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp13jaf5qli5xmgl1miup --listener-port 80 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLoadBalancerListener

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list.

The RegionId parameter is required if the endpoint of the region is slb.aliyuncs.com
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID。


当您所选地域的Endpoint（服务地址）为slb.aliyuncs.com时，RegionId必填
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port that is used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

This parameter is required if the same port is specified for listeners of different protocols
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。

相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填
parameters.name: listener_protocol
